answer: Cosignatures are collected in nectar, verified in pearl, and voyage names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 5 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 251 aliases cost 373 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
